title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Record and replay. Save every real Meko and Gemini response as JSON, then add a Demo Mode switch that replays them if Wi-Fi or limits fail.

Commit and tag. Commit every 30 to 45 minutes. Tag a safe build at 11 PM Saturday and the freeze build at 3 AM Sunday.

Measure while testing. Run each demo flow three times and write down times and counts. The Producer hand-checks the 50 RFP answers so you can quote a real accuracy figure.

Never edit the frozen build. After 3 AM Sunday only fix crashes, and only in a branch you can discard.

Pitch deck, demo script and rehearsal

The Producer builds the deck Saturday evening with blank number slots, fills them from real test runs Sunday morning, and the pair rehearses at least four times before 10:30 AM.

Deck (8 slides, 3 to 4 minutes of talking)

1. The person and the problem: a sales engineer at Nimbus Labs gets a 50-question security form from Meridian Bank.
